page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a printed ornamental band at top; no margin notes; a catchword "Theo-" at the lower right of the last line area.

main_text.head: REVERENDIS ITEM, CLARISS. CONSVLTISS. DOCTISSIMISQUE VIRIS, PRÆPOSITO, DECANO, CATERISQUE AD D. THOMAM CANONICIS OMNIBUS AC SINGULIS:
main_text.p: HISTORICAM HANC IVSTINI EPITOMEN, BREVIBUS ILLUSTRATAM NOTIS EXPLANATAMQUE, DEBITAE OBSERVANTIAE, amoris ac benevolentiae hoc (interea dum maiori liceat) qualicunq; argumento testificandæ gratia,
THEOPHILVS CANGISER SAXOHALENSIS, ALVMNORVM, qui Academico in Collegio sunt, moderator.

page.notes: The title block is set in large roman and italic type, with the ornamental band above. The line "D. O. C. Q." is a dedication abbreviation. A small mark "/" appears at lower right, and there are scattered show-through and stains; no marginal notes. The word "Theo-" is a catchword at the foot.
